78655.body:

Annie Crabill

Senior digital editor



 America’s blockbuster jobs report on Friday revealed that young workers, often cast as AI’s first victims, are holding up remarkably well. In fact, an AI hiring boom is under way. The technology is severely disrupting certain companies and workers. But The Economist estimates that AI has so far created around 1m new jobs in America. Our story explains 
 
https://click.e.economist.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5OTF9AAcAAAAABj360RN9BSiFNiRda6ZohtIBQpnPUhNKlGvyPod_AsbGoK1xEzODialgndCuoHulylID4hpnERVB3jbt0VMYoCTTXkKzqJFFYXpltPw 
how that’s playing out .
 


 In much of the world, the big battle for women is not the one for equal pay, but the one to be allowed to work outside the home at all.
